name: Apple Espana

theme.summary: Bright retail theater with pure white staging, radial product spotlighting, and SF Pro typography.
principles: Use white and frost surfaces as the product stage.
Let product imagery dominate every major section.
Use blue only for purchase actions, active links, and commerce navigation.
Keep text hierarchy centered, spare, and confident.
Avoid normal SaaS shadows and unrelated accents.

appleBlue.role: Primary CTA, buy button, active commerce action

linkBlue.role: Inline links, secondary CTA text, learn-more links

deepInk.role: Main headlines and highest contrast text

midGraphite.role: Nav text, body copy, product labels

systemGray.role: Legal text, inactive copy, muted labels

frost.role: Page bands, product tiles, nav wash

softFrost.role: Hero product background and clean product stage

pureWhite.role: Main page canvas and card surfaces

black.role: Footer text, device silhouettes, deep contrast

green.role: Environmental values, trade-in, availability, positive state

display.name: SF Pro Display
display.role: Hero headlines, product names, large display hierarchy

text.name: SF Pro Text
text.role: Body, nav, captions, buttons, product UI

icons.name: SF Pro Icons
icons.role: Inline Apple-style icon glyphs and chevrons

blueCTALink.decoration: none by default, underline on hover
blueCTALink.usage: learn more, view pricing, compare, configure

heroProductSection.title: 56px to 80px SF Pro Display 600
heroProductSection.ctaRow: blue text links or buy button plus link
heroProductSection.image: large device or product image, dominant visual

productTile.title: 28px to 40px 600
productTile.cta: blue link or small buy pill

ribbonBanner.role: financing, trade-in, delivery, promo, or help message

patterns: Centered hero with eyebrow, product name, large headline, subhead, CTA row, and dominant product image
Frosted top nav with compact links and bag/search icons
Product tile grids on frost backgrounds
Comparison cards with product image, specs, and small buy pill
Accessory cards with large product image and minimal text
Ribbon banners for trade-in, financing, delivery, and support messages
Dense legal footer with muted links and notes
layout.imagery: Real product renders or inspection-friendly product photography

motion.usage: Subtle UI transitions and restrained product transitions

do: Use SF Pro or Apple system fonts.
Use #0071e3 for buy actions and important commerce CTAs.
Use pill controls for buy actions.
Keep legal and footer content dense but muted.
dont: Do not add decorative gradients unless they are tied to product lighting.
Do not use custom display fonts.
Do not add heavy shadows around product tiles.
Do not use non-blue CTA colors.
Do not use card radius above 32px except for pills.
Do not place body text over product images.
Do not introduce multiple chromatic accents.
Do not use dark mode unless the product launch page specifically calls for it.
